recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, black-and-white portrait of a man in a leather jacket positioned in the lower right foreground, looking left across a body of water toward a dark industrial skyline. The composition is topped with two lines of widely spaced, teal-colored sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in foreground vs. industrial silhouette in background
Heavy film grain texture vs. clean geometric typography
Monochrome image vs. singular teal accent color in text
Horizontal water ripples vs. vertical industrial structures
coreInvariants: Dense, visible film grain across the entire frame
Extreme wide tracking (letter-spacing) in the typography
Subject looking away from the camera toward the horizon

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium-close-up portrait located in the bottom right quadrant, occupying approximately 30% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's profile and the dark leather jacket provide a heavy visual anchor in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the top-right text, follows the subject's gaze across the water to the industrial skyline on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of textured sky and water in the upper left and center creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale with heavy silver and charcoal tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black silhouettes of the jacket and industrial buildings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal or cyan used exclusively for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the water ripples; low saturation overall with a single-color typographic pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both lines to maintain minimalist industrial aesthetic.
graphicDevices: A small white circular dot placed between the two lines of text as a separator or focal point.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and circular proportions.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and uniform weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-grain black and white photograph of a man in a black leather jacket and white shirt, seen from the chest up in the bottom right corner. He is looking left toward a dark industrial harbor skyline across a body of water with visible ripples. The sky is overcast and grainy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase text in the top right corner using a bold geometric sans-serif font. Set the color to a muted teal. Apply extreme letter-spacing (tracking) so the words span across the top right quadrant. Place a small white solid circle between the two lines of text.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture heavy and consistent?
Is the text color specifically teal/cyan?
Is the tracking wide enough to create a sparse, airy feel?
Is the subject looking away from the camera?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the sky

postGenerationChecks: Check that the image is strictly black and white except for the text.
Ensure the text is right-aligned and does not touch the edges.
Verify the subject is in the lower right, not centered.
Confirm the presence of the small white dot between text lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy monochrome industrial landscape portrait with ultra-wide-tracked geometric sans-serif type in a single cool-toned accent color.
